title: CommandResponse
description: The response to a command, a union on disposition [M13] (docs/design/m0/08): applied, proposed (waiting for a confirmation) or refused. The CLI's exit code follows it: 0 applied, 3 proposed, 1 refused, 2 could_not_run, 4 a stale refusal.

CommandApplied.description: The command ran: its events, the approval it made (an authority-gated action) and its effects in their current states. A replay of an accepted command returns the same, with replayed set.

first_seq.description: The command's first event; 0 when it appended none.

result.description: The action's result; one schema per action.

issued_credential.description: A bearer string, tok_<id>.<secret>, that the command issued (14 N3): present only on the response that applied it, absent on a replay. It is never stored. Where the CLI keeps it is for 14 7a/7b to decide; until then the CLI refuses it (could_not_run) and never prints or writes it.

CommandProposed.description: The command needs a confirmation (04 "Proposals"): nothing was applied. A human policy is confirmed only on the dashboard (D37); the CLI prints the proposal, its effective change and the dashboard link (08 "CLI rules").

EffectiveChange.description: The effective change the proposal binds, as authority derived it from the command (04 "Action registry and effective-change classification"), never as the request named it: the action, the change classes it was classified by (the action's own included), the derived project (null: installation-wide), the derived object at its bound version and, for a grant change, the grantee. As in a proposal read (api/proposal), never the object's content digest.

object.description: The derived object: its type, id and bound version (null when it was bound by digest alone).

CommandRefused.description: Nothing was applied: failed (the command was decided and refused) or could_not_run (the controller or a dependency could not run it).

detail.description: Never empty for these outcomes (02). Whether the reason is registered for the outcome is the vocabulary's check (internal/vocab Registry.Check), run where the response is written and where it is read.
